ability_to_pay: Mixed. Positive: Garware Application Studio listing, Marine PPF (premium tiers with 5/8-year warranty), a custom booking site recently built, a 6-category service business on SG Highway (a premium area). Negative: only 426 Instagram followers, new-looking social presence, no ad evidence (Ad Library not checked, not cheap), no review volume known. Offer is about Rs 15-25k setup plus about Rs 5k/month, which is plausible but not proven.
resistance: Has an own site with a booking form already built (a vendor may exist); our 'booking page' half is largely done, only the 'proof' half is missing. Site is clearly in launch phase, so the owner may fill the galleries himself. Garware may supply marketing material. Owner name and who answers the 91063 number are unknown.
case_for: Real single-outlet studio, identity confirmed in three places (own site, Garware locator with identical address, Google Maps link). A need we SEE and that is literally true today: both gallery pages on their own site say no photos or videos yet, there is no review block, and no packages by car size, which is exactly the proof half of our offer. They are investing (new site, Garware studio, premium Marine PPF), so they are in a build phase and open to tools. A published wa.me WhatsApp number exists.
case_against: The gap is a 'not yet filled' state on a new site, not neglect, and the booking half of our offer already exists, so the pitch is narrower than for a studio with no site. It is not one of the campaign's a/b/c/d slots and nothing is proven about Google reviews or the profile (Maps unreadable). Pay signal is weak to moderate (426 followers, no ads known). It is a general auto shop with six service lines, not a pure detailer. Owner not named; two different phone numbers; no proof the WhatsApp number reaches the decider. Possible existing web vendor.
best_angle: One literally true sentence: 'your site has a booking form, but the photo and video galleries say no projects have been added yet'. Offer to build the proof side: before/after gallery, Google reviews block, packages by car size next to the existing Book button. Never say customers are lost. Do not mention the Garware listing as leverage beyond saying we saw it, and no prices in the message.
best_channel: WhatsApp, human-approved, to +91 91063 26281 (the number the studio itself publishes with a wa.me link on its own site). It is the studio's own line, but who reads it is not proven, so open by asking for the owner. Do not use 9825033072 (published by Garware, not by the studio). Not email.
